description: The initial stage where the seed breaks dormancy and the radicle emerges. This typically occurs in the nursery or propagation area before transfer to the NFT system.
visual_indicators: Emergence of cotyledons from the propagation media
maturity_context: Not mature. Highly vulnerable to environmental fluctuations.

description: The stage following germination where the first true leaves appear. The young plant is developing a basic root system to support initial vegetative growth.
expected_development: Appearance of the first set of true leaves
visual_indicators: Presence of small, developing true leaves
Plant is small relative to the growing hole
Foliage color is typically light to medium green
maturity_context: Juvenile stage. Often the stage at which plants are transplanted into the main NFT channels.

description: The plant adapts to the NFT system, rapidly expanding its root network in the nutrient stream to support increasing leaf biomass.
expected_development: Rapid expansion of the root mat in the channel
visual_indicators: Leaves become broader and darker green
Plant begins to cover the immediate area around the growing hole
maturity_context: Intermediate stage. Roots are established, and growth accelerates.

description: The period of maximum leaf production and biomass accumulation. The rosette structure becomes dense and well-defined.
expected_development: Continuous production of new leaves from the center
Leaves may develop savoyed (crinkled) textures depending on variety
visual_indicators: Leaves may overlap with neighboring plants in the channel
Consistent dark green coloration across mature leaves
maturity_context: Approaching maturity. Some outer leaves may be suitable for early harvest.

description: The crop has reached optimal commercial or culinary size. Growth rate plateaus, and the plant must be harvested before bolting occurs.
expected_development: Increased risk of bolting if environmental stress occurs
visual_indicators: Maximum canopy diameter for the growing spacing
No signs of stem elongation (which would indicate bolting)
maturity_context: Fully mature. Ready for whole-plant harvest or continued cut-and-come-again harvesting.

description: The process of tracking individual plants over time to assess growth rate and trajectory. Repeated observations of the same permanent plant_id over time can be used to estimate growth progression and trend after sufficient labeled project data has been collected.
expected_development: Transitioning sequentially from G0 to G4 over time
visual_indicators: Relative increase in canopy size compared to previous observations
Changes in leaf morphology over sequential images
maturity_context: Provides temporal context to evaluate whether growth velocity aligns with expected developmental timelines.
